gitCommit.subject: Test: wait for the document language after a language switch, rather than race it
gitCommit.body:
Test: wait for the document language after a language switch, rather than race it

CI on tsx-public-site (run 39040460157, commit de6e6ba) failed 1/103: the
language-switch test read <html lang> the instant the address changed, one
render before the app sets it (it read en/ltr for an ar page). The site was
right a moment later; the same test passed on site-redesign and against the
live domain. It now polls. 45/45 repeated runs pass locally.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
